description_en: Invoke ListHotlineRecord to query the hotline recording list by hotline session ID
description_zh: 调用ListHotlineRecord根据热线会话ID查询热线录音列表
name: ListHotlineRecord

parameters.help_en: Unique customer request ID. Used for idempotency validation. You can generate it using UUID
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一ID。用于幂等校验，可以用UUID生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: AICCS instance ID. You can obtain it from the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。可在智能联络中心控制台上获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: Session ID. This corresponds to the acid in WebSocket after an inbound call
parameters.name: call_id
